converted_details.en: The Base64 result is now on the clipboard
converted_details.zh-Hans: Base64 结果已写入剪贴板

empty_clipboard.en: The clipboard does not contain text to convert
empty_clipboard.zh-Hans: 剪贴板中没有可转换的文本

read_failed.en: Could not read text from the clipboard

action.script:
input="$NOTCH_TEMP_DIR/clipboard.txt"
output="$NOTCH_TEMP_DIR/base64.txt"

if ! /usr/bin/pbpaste > "$input"; then
  print -u2 -- "$(notch_t read_failed)"
  exit 1
fi

if [[ ! -s "$input" ]]; then
  print -u2 -- "$(notch_t empty_clipboard)"
  exit 1
fi

if ! /usr/bin/base64 < "$input" | LC_ALL=C /usr/bin/tr -d '\r\n' > "$output"; then
  print -u2 -- "$(notch_t conversion_failed)"
  exit 1
fi

/usr/bin/pbcopy < "$output"
notch_result --summary "$(notch_t converted_summary)" --details "$(notch_t converted_details)"
